steps.content: The steady throb in your wrist serves as a grounding force amidst the whirl of the stage.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hmph... so you want me to make choices?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, I've made my mind!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Sword in hand, aimed at the dancer
Standing tall, gaze at the dancer

steps.content: Your eyes lock onto the magnificent aerial dancer. You feel a release in your hand and the crowd stepping back as you declare your choice.
Still, they cluster around the stage, awaiting your next move with bated breath.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now, I'm destined to be... the one who cuts all ties of control.
Gripping your sword in a backhanded style, you dash towards the dancer, facing down her extravagantly massive skirt that's almost eerie in its grandeur.
The red lips adorning the skirt's edge show the sharp fangs within, emitting a relentless, jarring chewing noise, as if gnawing away at everyone's fantasies.
You give a measured bow, lifting your sword again to stand ready before you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm taking back my friends and shattering every illusion!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'll be the one to rewrite this cowardly and false narrative!
Your eyes lock onto the magnificent aerial dancer. You feel a release in your hand and the crowd stepping back as you declare your choice.
A wave of lethal intent and hostility hits you in an instant, as the performers, under the aerial dancer's sway, all turn their aggression towards you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Isn't it a bit unsporting for all these people to come at me alone?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm just not interested in being your idea of a hero—the Sword of the Brave and Hero, that's the script you've written for me, right?
Sensing the watchful eyes of the audience behind you, you smile and go on.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm following my own script... The part I play in the real world, that's the character I'm embodying at this moment.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's time to grasp that some people won't let go of their actual lives for some phony dream.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Even without following your storyline, without playing your parts... I'm determined to save my friends.

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: You, you're not one of the cast... you don't belong on this stage...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: You're wrecking this performance... you're not meant to... be here...
With the silver sword in hand, you valiantly resist the performers' attacks.
Their sheer number, however, soon puts you on the back foot, struggling to keep up.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Tsk... looks like... I really should listen to Nightingale more...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've got to up my training...
With a resounding crash, your silver sword is sent flying from your grasp, landing forcefully in the steps beside you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hah... Ruining the show shouldn't be a death wish, right?
You back away slowly, but the crowd is merciless, lashing out at you with full force.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: ...No one touches Chief!!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: S-stop... Stop it!
The assault from the crowd comes to a sudden stop, thanks to your two allies stepping in front of you.
They're still a bit wobbly, like they've just snapped out of a coma.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I've got to... let Chief try out the dish I made by myself...

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Chief promised... to be there for my debut when I'm the star of the show...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That means we can't just fall here and now.
Grasping their offered hands, you swiftly stand up.
The cutting of two silken threads leaves the aerialist hanging in a frozen moment—she's slow to react, and the spectators below are just as puzzled.
All three of you turn to the audience, finding Lady Pearl there, observing you closely.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Fascinating, it's the first time I've witnessed... someone willingly stepping out of my script.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: What, are you regretting the life you've chosen for yourselves?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Or does this life no longer satisfy your desire?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: I'm not regretting it, it's just...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: If that life doesn't include Chief, it's not the one I really want.
The two speak their mind almost without thinking.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I do crave a normal, mundane life, however appealing that may seem...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The person I'm longing for isn't actually with me; I can't feel real love, nor can I truly love them back.
Ignis checks her pocket, finding it empty as she thought.
The apple given to her by the girl is gone.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Sigh, I understand...
Lady Pearl lifts her hand, signaling you to turn back and observe the frozen performers.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I'm truly impressed that you made that choice.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: But, have you really thought it through?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Do you really... not want to be the hero who ends all this?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I know you've got the skill and the gift for it.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Plus... you're definitely capable of waking up from that dream, aren't you?
Lady Pearl's eyes gleam with a touch of madness as she offers another choice.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Might as well give it a shot.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But you'll never be able to script my ideal life.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm not meant to be a hero, nor will I let others pull my strings. But now that everyone's here... I guess a little performance wouldn't hurt, especially with these amazing stage effects of yours.
You approach the staircase, effortlessly drawing your silver sword.
Heading back to the stage, your attire gains clarity and detail with every step you take.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But after this, I'm set on bringing everyone back to the Bureau.
Only when you make it to the heart of the stage do you notice you're already in your grand costume, gripping the sword, side by side with your allies.
Together, you face the dancer in the sky.
